Oracle Java Users Urged to Update Systems Amid Cyber Attack Risk

Users of Oracle Java have been alerted to a cyber attack risk due to identified flaws, prompting calls for immediate security updates. The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) and South Korea's cybersecurity agency have urged companies to update their systems. Java is widely used in critical information infrastructure, including government agencies and military systems.
